slow onion soup with toasts

Synthetic narrative paragraph one. Things I learned:

  • Be patient with the onions.
  • Use a wide pot.
Slow Onion Soup with Toasts
  • Servings: 6
  • Source: Test Home Cook

Ingredients

  • 2 tablespoons unsalted butter
  • 1 1/2 pounds yellow onions, thinly sliced
  • 1 teaspoon kosher salt
  • 1/2 cup dry white wine
  • 4 cups beef or vegetable stock
  • Freshly ground black pepper
  • 4 to 6 thick slices baguette
  • 1 cup coarsely grated Gruyère

Melt the butter. Cook the onions low and slow.
